# The numeric stack the *browser* actually runs (Pyodide 0.27.7 = CPython
# 3.12.7; see web/src/workers/pyodideShared.ts PYODIDE_VERSION and the
# pyodide-lock.json it ships).  The CI `test-browser-pins` job runs the suite
# under these so an API that only exists in newer numpy/scipy fails in CI
# instead of at runtime in a user's browser.  Bump together with PYODIDE_VERSION.
